lifecycle.retention: Retain source versions and projections until whole-migration acceptance and lifecycle review.

steps: Deny Bluetooth Connect/Scan while keeping system location permission and repeat live azimuth and stakeout, including Home and Stop
On an isolated emulator revoke both location permissions and verify rejected starts show a plain message, stop live mode and release GPS/audio without crashing
Connect the production geodetic receiver path and verify it publishes corrected WGS84 GPS fixes for the pole tip
Configure stakeout thresholds 5, 1, 0.5 and 0.1 metres and enable sound
Select editable and read-only Point, LineString, Polygon and their Multi variants, then start Слежение
Approach a point, a line segment interior, a polygon exterior boundary and an interior ring from both sides
For a polygon, repeat while starting inside its area
Cross every threshold repeatedly and hold at 0.1 m with both good accuracy and a constant coarse value such as 10 m
Stand still and rotate the device, then walk along a known bearing while turning the device independently
Compare the displayed magnetic azimuth with a control bearing plus known local WMM2025 declination, including wrap around 0/360 degrees

Change the declination correction during measurement, confirm the magnetic azimuth and the declination line update immediately to D+C, restart the app and verify the correction persists, then reset it to 0
Repeat on a device/emulator without a rotation-vector sensor and compare the arrow with a known north-up and explicitly rotated map bearing

Open the single Measurements button, dismiss without selecting, then start Ruler and each azimuth mode; finish each tool and verify the same button returns; hide Ruler in settings, recreate and verify both azimuth choices remain
Open Measurements, select Azimuth from my location, drag and replace the target, and verify the fixed GPS endpoint, temporary segment and result update after release

Select point A to point B, choose two arbitrary points, drag A and B independently, verify every released position recalculates the result, then test coincident points and tap a third point to begin a new measurement

On a narrow portrait screen verify the numeric magnetic-azimuth value remains visible below its label instead of being clipped - Mute and unmute the widget, rotate portrait/landscape, lock the screen and press Home for several minutes, then resume and stop the mode

Repeat with GPS loss/stale fixes, a network fallback, a mock-GPS receiver application, Bluetooth active and a non-normal Android audio mode - Export the debug log and verify it does not contain stakeout coordinates or extended mock Location samples
Open map settings after upgrading an existing install, verify Keep map screen on and both photo-coordinate options are initially enabled, disable them, restart and verify the explicit choice persists
Run a 4–8 hour field session and assess sound fatigue, battery use and CPU temperature
value.expected:
The widget contains direction, WGS84 distance, numeric WMM2025 magnetic azimuth, reported horizontal accuracy, effective declination D+C, a persisted declination correction, mute and stop for live guidance; it never duplicates object name or coordinate source. Point uses its coordinate, line uses the nearest segment point and polygon uses the nearest outer/inner boundary even from inside. Sound cadence changes at configured distances without overlapping, chattering or using network fixes for precision guidance. Coarse or placeholder accuracy remains visible but does not silence GPS/mock distance bands. The final cue occurs once only after two fresh precision fixes
  whose distance is within tolerance. Stale/lost GPS silences audio; screen-off and background
  state keep cues and high-frequency GPS active under an ongoing silent notification. Foreground
  resume restores the widget, and explicit stop removes the notification and restores ordinary
  location sampling. Device rotation follows the filtered magnetic phone compass
both stationary and moving; without it true bearing minus map bearing is used. The current-to-point mode updates a non-persistent segment, lets only the target be dragged and retains live GPS/audio behavior. Point A to B uses the same geodesic and magnetic-bearing calculation without GPS/audio, returns undefined azimuth for coincident points, lets either endpoint be corrected by dragging and starts a new A after the completed pair. Declination correction changes the magnetic azimuth and the displayed effective declination immediately, survives process restart and returns to 0 only after an explicit reset. Drag hints are not shown in the widget. The numeric magnetic azimuth is visible on narrow screens. Mock GPS from the receiver remains accepted, navigation cues remain audible with Bluetooth/audio-mode changes,
  use a loud short damped tap rather than a high sustained tone, and system volume can reduce it.
  The migrated photo defaults do not overwrite later explicit user choices. Debug logs do not
  contain stakeout coordinate samples or extended mock Location fields.
